tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and window ground behind everything. The sidebar and the content canvas both sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, popovers, sheets and the inspector panel — anything that sits on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Filled controls at rest: text-field fill, segmented-control track, secondary button, table header row.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash for rows, list items and plain buttons on `surface-raised`. Never a selection colour.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, active sidebar item, tinted button fill. Pair with `accent-text` for its label.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`. Also every heading.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text — labels, descriptions, table headers — on `surface` and `surface-raised`. 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps and metadata on `surface-raised` only (4.7:1). On `surface` in the light theme it reads 4.3:1 — use `ink-secondary` there.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `ink` fills (tooltips). Not for text on `accent` — that is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, card outlines, table row rules. Decorative only — it carries no meaning, so it may sit below 3:1.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of a text field, checkbox or toggle track in the off state, on `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` (3:1 or better).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue. Primary button fill, toggle-on track, progress, selection ring, focus ring. Text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` and `accent-hover`. Dark theme lightens the accent, so this flips to black — never hard-code white.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, plain-button labels, tinted-button labels, and text on `surface-selected`. 4.9:1 or better on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-selected`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status dot, icon and toggle-on alternative for 'paid', 'delivered', 'won'. Never text — use `success-text`.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a success badge or callout. Label in `success-text`.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success text on `success-soft` and `surface-raised` (4.8:1+). Always paired with a word or icon — green and red are told apart by label, not hue.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status dot and icon for 'pending', 'awaiting payment', 'low stock'. Orange, not yellow, so it stays distinct from `danger` for colour-blind readers.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a warning badge or callout. Label in `warning-text`.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on `warning-soft` and `surface-raised` (6:1+).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error icon, the edge of a field in error, status dot for 'cancelado', 'devolución', 'perdido'. Never a text or button fill colour — the destructive Button is `danger-soft` with a `danger-text` label (white on this red is 3.5:1).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a danger badge, inline error or destructive confirmation.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error text under a field, danger badge label, on `danger-soft` and `surface-raised` (5:1+).

tokens.name: channel-instagram
tokens.usage: Only the Instagram channel glyph beside a conversation or order source. Never a fill, never text.

tokens.name: channel-whatsapp
tokens.usage: Only the WhatsApp channel glyph beside a conversation or order source. Never a fill, never text.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and modals.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark only, always lowercase, with the mark in place of the g (see README › Logo). Login header, splash, printed quotes. Never for UI text.

styles.name: wordmark-sm
styles.usage: Wordmark beside the 24px mark in SidebarNav and in document headers.

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: The store descriptor under the wordmark, lowercase, in `ink-secondary`. Nothing else is tracked this wide.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most — the dashboard headline number or an empty-state title.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen title in the content header.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section title inside a screen, StatCard value.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card title, contact name in a detail header, sheet title.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Emphasised body — list-item primary text, form group label, button label at size lg.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pedido confirmado y listo para despacho.
styles.usage: Default reading size. Table cells, form values, descriptions, md button label.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a primary one; sidebar items; sm button label; field hints.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Timestamps, metadata, table header text (set in `ink-secondary`).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badge labels (uppercase), stat labels, sidebar section headers. Minimum size in the system.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Order numbers, SKUs, tracking codes and tabular money columns where digits must align.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control; between stacked form fields' label and input; badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding (md); gap between sibling controls in a toolbar; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and sheet padding; table cell horizontal padding; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Form section gap; sidebar horizontal inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Content canvas inset on all sides; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above a section title; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top inset of the content canvas under the screen title; hero spacing on the dashboard.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, small (sm) buttons, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields, md buttons, segmented control and its thumb, sidebar items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, StatCards, table containers, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, modals and the inspector panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons (the Apple-style call to action), avatars, toggle track and thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and StatCards on `surface`. Pair with a `hairline` outline — the shadow alone is too faint to define an edge in dark.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the date picker.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and modals over `scrim`.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: Segmented-control thumb and toggle knob.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Whole-control opacity for a disabled button, field or toggle. Do not also grey the text.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover washes, toggle knob, segmented thumb.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Sheets and popovers entering, row expand.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Every transition in the system. One curve.
